title: zazzle run operations
description: `zazzled wrap`, which `zazzle run` reaches by exec (macos/c/zazzle); on Intel Macs, which have no invoker, it is run as `zazzled wrap` directly.

entities.name: zazzle run
entities.description: Runs a command and prints its output cleaned, then exits with the command's code.
entities.transport: zazzle run [--lossless] [--budget T] [--timeout SECS] [--profile NAME|none] [--] CMD ARGS.. (exec'd as `zazzled wrap ...`)
entities.authorization: Whoever runs it; the command runs with the caller's environment, working directory, standard input and permissions. Nothing else is checked.
entities.result: The command's merged standard output and error, cleaned with its profile (detected, or named with --profile) and clean's steps within --budget (default 8000), then `[exit N in Ts; ...]` naming a timeout, cut output and what the profile dropped. With an output store it starts with `[r:ID]` and, when anything was dropped or cut, ends with `[full output: read-again r:ID --full]`; a store that cannot be written leaves it untagged with `[output not stored for read-again: ...]`. The exit status is the command's: its code, 128 + N for signal N, or 124 when it was killed after --timeout (default 3600 s).
failures: No command, an unknown option, a number below 1 for --budget or --timeout, or an unknown profile name: `zazzled: ...` with the usage or the profile names, exit 2.
The command cannot be started: `zazzled: cannot run CMD: ...`, exit 2.
The pipe cannot be created: `zazzled: cannot create a pipe: ...`, exit 2.
